defaultFilteringModeDescription.message: This is the starting shield for every website. You can dial protection up or down per site — each level trades coverage against breakage, so pick whatever fits the site you're on.
defaultFilteringModeDescription.description: This describes the default filtering mode setting

basicFilteringModeDescription.message:
Light network filtering from your selected filter lists.

Needs no special permissions — the gentle option for sites that misbehave under heavier blocking.

optimalFilteringModeDescription.message:
Stronger network filtering plus targeted cosmetic filtering from your selected filter lists.

Asks for permission to read and modify data on websites.

completeFilteringModeDescription.message:
Maximum filtering: advanced network blocking plus full cosmetic filtering.

Asks for broad permission to read and modify data on websites.

May use more resources, and fragile sites are more likely to break.

noFilteringModeDescription.message: Websites on this list get no filtering at all. Your call.
